name: Meadow in summer
desc: Childhood, reprieve, the good scene before the bad one - warmth with no threat anywhere in it.
tags: scenery, no humans, summer meadow, tall grass, grass seed heads, scattered wildflowers, white and yellow flowers, butterflies, blue sky, cumulus clouds, distant treeline, dirt track through grass
prose: a summer meadow of tall grass gone to seed with white and yellow wildflowers scattered through it, butterflies over the grass heads, a dirt track worn across it and a distant treeline under tall cumulus
note: Comes back as a mown lawn, or as a solid carpet of identical blooms if flower field creeps in - ask for tall grass and seed heads and keep the flowers SCATTERED. The distant treeline and the cloud stack are the only depth cues; drop them and it is a flat green void with no horizon.
